summary: PR 2448 is valid test-only hardening for restore ordering and index coverage. It changes no production implementation, and its new tests pass unchanged on the recorded base, so it is not a failing-before/passing-after fix. The full H20 CP=8/DP=8 Mooncake restart failure remains unverified.

tests.command: temporarily replace the base test_decode_hicache_tree_core.py with the file from a171524, then /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-c071f888d3ca/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_decode_hicache_tree_core.py
tests.what_was_measured: All five tests, including the candidate's three L3-only restore tests, passed against production source at the recorded base; this establishes that the candidate is test-only hardening rather than a failing-before regression.
At exact candidate a171524ccc35794fcd1bbd5501cd8ea61d0a3bff, 25 focused CPU tests passed across HiCache restore gating, transfer cleanup, and radix lock ownership.
Independent adversarial checks verified 63/64 incomplete coverage fails, mixed L1/L2/L3 restores exactly the non-L1 suffix, and transport failure is not hidden by the success gate.

gpu_evidence: Torch detected one AMD Instinct MI355X with capability (9, 5), ROCm 7.2, and checkout-local SGLang source. The issue-specific tests were CPU mock/control-flow tests and did not execute GPU kernels.
remaining_counterexamples: A real decode restart after an L3-only persistent HiCache match under Mooncake could still expose an ordering or persistence race not represented by synchronous mocks.
The reported CP=8 prefill plus DP=8 decode topology can have cross-rank behavior not covered by single-process unit tests.
NVIDIA H20/CUDA behavior is not qualified by the available single AMD gfx950/ROCm device.
The tests do not prove full-model KV correctness or semantic output accuracy after restoration.
remaining_limitations: No eight-rank prefill CP plus eight-rank decode DP deployment was available.
No NVIDIA H20/CUDA device, Mooncake persistent-storage fixture, model weights, or restart-capable distributed serving setup was supplied.
Candidate and adversarial tests validate mocked control flow and tensor-index coverage only.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
